description: Defines classes and serialization types for XNNPack operator contexts (Linear, Conv2d, TransposeConv2d) used in PyTorch's XNNPack backend, including context creation and resource management.

classes.name: LinearOpContext
classes.description: Abstract base class for linear operator context, manages original weights/biases and serialization.

classes.name: XNNPackLinearOpContext
classes.description: Concrete implementation of LinearOpContext for XNNPack, manages runtime execution and resource cleanup.

classes.name: Conv2dOpContext
classes.description: Abstract base class for 2D convolution operator context, manages weights, biases, and parameters.

classes.name: TransposeConv2dOpContext
classes.description: Abstract base class for transpose convolution operator context, manages weights, biases, and parameters.

classes.name: XNNPackConv2dOpContext
classes.description: Final class for 2D convolution context with XNNPack, includes indirection buffer management.

classes.name: XNNPackTransposeConv2dOpContext
classes.description: Final class for transpose 2D convolution context with XNNPack, includes indirection buffer management.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Returns stored weights, biases, and min/max values for serialization.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the operator context on input tensor.

methods.name: free_orig_weight_and_bias
methods.description: Frees original weight and bias resources.

methods.name: create_context
methods.description: Creates a new operator context with specified parameters.
